title: Computational complexity of static output feedback stabilization
summary: We study the computational complexity of static output feedback (SOF) stabilization for continuous-time linear systems. For rational plant data, we prove that this problem is complete for the existential theory of the reals: it is equivalent, under polynomial-time transformations, to deciding whether a system of polynomial equations and inequalities with integer coefficients has a real solution.
